svg.aria-label: Twenty-six threat rows grouped by attacker, each with the lowest VSLA level that acts on it and a glyph for defeated, mitigated, recorded or out of scope
svg.title: Where each threat stops
svg.text: Modelled on the SLSA threat table, with three words used precisely. The glyph at a level says what that level does;
a second glyph to the right says what a higher level adds. Twenty-five threats; T2 is split into edits and omissions.
THE ATTACKER IS THE FINDER OR ITS OPERATOR
